Description: Conduct current-state process mapping workshops with warehouse and fulfillment teams across three distribution centers. Document cycle times and identify bottlenecks in order-to-ship workflow
Analyze 18 months of operational data to benchmark throughput and error rates against industry peers. Build statistical model identifying root causes of fulfillment delays exceeding SLA thresholds
Conduct stakeholder interviews with VP of Operations and three regional directors. Synthesize findings on organizational readiness and change management risks for transformation program
Develop future-state operating model with recommended organizational structure and role definitions. Design KPI dashboard framework with leading and lagging indicators for operational excellence
Build financial impact model projecting cost savings from proposed process improvements. Quantify labor efficiency gains and inventory carrying cost reductions across a three-year horizon
Facilitate executive alignment workshop with C-suite to review transformation roadmap and prioritize initiative sequencing. Guide consensus on quick wins vs. structural changes
Prepare 45-page Board presentation synthesizing diagnostic findings and strategic recommendations. Include implementation timeline with dependencies and resource requirements by workstream
Develop detailed change management and communications plan for Phase 1 rollout. Define training curriculum for new warehouse management system and draft stakeholder FAQ document
